status: pre-design; expected role signatures remain pending

authority.expectedPolicy: Read actual frozen originals and independent literal role/style expectations; never ask product functions to generate their own expected output.

requirements.expected: Architecture bytes, sourceBindingDigest, sourceFacts, sourceDigest, irDigest, all canonical source/target node+port bindings, tensorId, role, scene IDs, canonicalEdgeIds and hidden-edge partition remain exactly equal to the corresponding baseline. Every canonical edge occurs once in visible membership or hiddenEdges. No relabeling of data/residual/memory/mask facts.

expandedIds, pins, aliases, manual layout/layoutByFrontier, nodes, header/card/repeat geometry, ports and their order/identity/coordinates/proxy membership remain exactly equal. Existing edge paths and user edge labels/positions remain exactly equal for untouched inputs. Role ornamentation must not create unnecessary routing changes.

All six CNN paper baseline Scenes, publication SVGs and interactive SVGs retain their old bytes for the same document/revision. Historical Transformer paper semantic/geometry checks retain their original scope; new browser coverage must be separately collected. A harmless shared serialization change, if deliberately approved, needs an explicit bounded exception rather than silently stripping fields.

Four canonical edge roles have independently specified, distinguishable noncolor signatures. The actual published and interactive paths must use those signatures when no local override replaces them. Memory and mask must remain different. Source-provided edge labels remain intact; text that explains a role must not fabricate a tensor name, source symbol or model operation.

Explicit width/dashed/stroke overrides retain document bytes and supported precedence. Explicit dashed false must remain a real solid override; explicit dashed true must be represented in both modes. Differently authored styles remain separate canonical display branches, including color-only styles in monochrome that historically remain split. Same-tensor edges with distinct roles or styles must not merge. Hidden-edge inspector fallback must not claim a style different from the displayed resolved binding.

A role legend reflects actual visible roles and emitted line signatures, includes no hidden-only role and is distinguishable from node-category symbols. Manual legend IDs/text/order/color/glyph, annotations and CanvasDocument arrays remain unchanged. Defaults and locally overridden styles must be described truthfully; a default sample must not claim that an overridden edge shares it. Generated role samples must not collide with manual IDs.

New role samples/text fit the actual page bounds and do not overlap node bodies, ancestor headers, repeat backplates or retained legend/annotation objects. The scene bounds may grow only for new visible ornaments; they must not crop existing objects. Any generated edge-role caption needs a separate label/body/header/other-label geometry check and actual local pixel inspection. Independently measure new marker/stroke extents. Do not claim global collision freedom when an edited baseline contains pre-existing conflicts.

Scene, public interactive SVG and actual publication SVG expose the same canonical facts, paths, role styles and legend meanings, compared within each mode. Publication omits interactive handles. Detail exports preserve selected scope partition, canonical boundary bindings and role signatures for newly created boundary edges. Scene/interactive/publication complete XML equality is not required across modes.

Native preset change is one supported page operation and one undo history item; undo restores prior preset and redo restores monochrome without changing architecture/layout/styles. Save persists that exact document/revision; real reload and fresh export bind the actual saved envelope and actual export UUID/source files. No browser-state injection or replacement with a stateless regeneration.

Independent tests and AI pixels remain machine/AI evidence. A readable fit image is not physical 85/180 mm publication approval, real researcher task completion, fonts/hardware certification, global route beauty or presented performance. Record fit-only or unreadable details explicitly.

negativeControls: Coherently mutate a canonical role in Scene and SVG; preservation oracle rejects it.
Swap memory/mask literal line signatures; role oracle rejects it even with unchanged source metadata.
Merge same-tensor data/residual bindings or omit a canonical branch; coverage oracle rejects it.
Suppress explicit dashed:false, or consolidate distinct override branches; override oracle rejects it.
Describe a hidden-only role in automatic role legend, or mutate/delete a manual legend item; legend oracle rejects it.
Move a generated label into a body/header or outside page bounds; geometry oracle rejects it.
Change source facts, endpoint coordinates, pin/manual layout or existing route while changing only preset; preservation oracle rejects it.

scopeRecommendation.static: CNN 12 frozen cases; four historical Transformer documents used as source-bound observations for all four roles; renamed literal role graph; explicit solid/dashed and same-role style split; expanded detail with boundary data/residual/memory/mask; empty/hidden-only edge role; custom legends/annotations; deterministic render and detached source; history/serialization.
scopeRecommendation.browserMinimum: CNN mono L0/L1/L2 at 85 and 180 mm (6); Transformer mono overview and expanded memory/mask detail at 180 mm (2); one CNN paper180 reference (1); on the CNN mono overview perform native preset undo/redo/save/reload/new export. Add actual local images for each unreadable fit and any new role caption/sample.
scopeRecommendation.publicationPixels: Inspect the actual exported SVG or its derived raster at final physical 85/180 mm scale separately from UI fit/local screenshots. If that cannot be done, keep physical publication unapproved.
scopeRecommendation.requiredBeforeTests: Root must provide final literal role signature, override precedence, legend content/placement and approved new Scene fields. Preserve this pre-design file; write the final contract under a new filename.
